completeCard.name: Arcane Bolt
completeCard.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

completeCard.name: Arcane Shield
completeCard.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeCard.effect: Arcane Shield. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, abjuration, protection. Trigger when an attack roll would hit you. Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of your next regular turn, potentially causing the attack to miss. Temporary AC from another Arcane Shield does not stack.

source.originalText: Arcane Shield: Create a barrier of magical force that provides temporary protection.

completeCard.name: Arcane Insight
completeCard.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

completeCard.name: Spell Scribing
completeCard.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

source.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

completeCard.name: Spellbook Study
completeCard.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

source.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

completeCard.name: Scholarly Mind
completeCard.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

source.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

completeCard.name: Arcane Sight
completeCard.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

completeCard.name: Sigil Rewrite
completeCard.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

completeCard.name: Matrix Efficiency
completeCard.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

completeCard.name: Matrix Mastery
completeCard.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

completeCard.name: Floating Preparation
completeCard.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

completeCard.name: Spell Tether
completeCard.effect: Spell Tether. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, concentration, tether. When you begin a second concentration spell that targets only yourself while already concentrating on a self-only spell, spend 3 additional RP. For up to 3 rounds you may maintain both. Whenever damage requires a concentration save, make one save; failure ends BOTH spells. Starting a third concentration effect ends both tethered spells before the new one begins. Spell Tether and Tethered Cast cannot be combined; maximum two sustained concentration effects total. Only one Spell Tether can exist at a time.

source.originalText: Spell Tether: Maintain 2 self-buff spells without concentration (1/rest)

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet

source.originalText: Seal Magic: Prevent a target from casting spells of a specific school (WIS save, 3 rounds)

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

completeCard.name: Arcane Bolt
completeCard.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

completeCard.name: Arcane Shield
completeCard.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeCard.effect: Arcane Shield. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, abjuration, protection. Trigger when an attack roll would hit you. Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of your next regular turn, potentially causing the attack to miss. Temporary AC from another Arcane Shield does not stack.

source.originalText: Arcane Shield: Create a barrier of magical force that provides temporary protection.

completeCard.name: Arcane Insight
completeCard.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

completeCard.name: Spell Scribing
completeCard.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

source.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

completeCard.name: Spellbook Study
completeCard.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

source.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

completeCard.name: Scholarly Mind
completeCard.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

source.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

completeCard.name: Arcane Sight
completeCard.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

completeCard.name: Sigil Rewrite
completeCard.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

completeCard.name: Matrix Efficiency
completeCard.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

completeCard.name: Matrix Mastery
completeCard.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

completeCard.name: Floating Preparation
completeCard.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

completeCard.name: Spell Tether
completeCard.effect: Spell Tether. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, concentration, tether. When you begin a second concentration spell that targets only yourself while already concentrating on a self-only spell, spend 3 additional RP. For up to 3 rounds you may maintain both. Whenever damage requires a concentration save, make one save; failure ends BOTH spells. Starting a third concentration effect ends both tethered spells before the new one begins. Spell Tether and Tethered Cast cannot be combined; maximum two sustained concentration effects total. Only one Spell Tether can exist at a time.

source.originalText: Spell Tether: Maintain 2 self-buff spells without concentration (1/rest)

completeCard.name: Improved Concentration
completeCard.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

completeCard.name: Dispel Magic
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
completeCard.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

completeCard.name: Spell Preservation
completeCard.effect: Spell Preservation. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, spellbook. Your primary spellbook cannot be destroyed, erased or rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. It can still be stolen, hidden, transported, suppressed, sealed by an artifact-level effect or voluntarily abandoned. Copies and backup books do not automatically receive this protection.

source.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

completeCard.name: Seal Magic
completeCard.effect: Seal Magic. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, control. Choose one of the eight schools and target one creature. It makes a Wisdom save. On failure it cannot cast spells of the chosen school. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the Seal on success. The effect ends automatically after 3 rounds and never prevents non-spell class techniques merely because they are magical.

source.originalText: Seal Magic: Prevent a target from casting spells of a specific school (WIS save, 3 rounds)

completeCard.name: Arcane Lock
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
completeCard.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

completeCard.name: Knowledge Shield
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
completeCard.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeCard.frequency: At most once per ally per round
completeCard.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

completeCard.name: Dimensional Pocket
completeCard.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

automaticCards.name: Arcane Tradition
automaticCards.frequency: Automatic at Wizard 3; not a selection
automaticCards.effect: Arcane Tradition. Tags: arch, school, automatic. Your level-1 Arcane School becomes your Arcanist tradition; do not choose a second school. Prepare one additional matrix from that same school each day without counting it against your normal prepared-matrix maximum. It otherwise obeys all ordinary rank, spellbook, Dissonance and duplicate-family rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

automaticCards.name: Counterspell
automaticCards.cost: 3 RP
automaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
automaticCards.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

automaticCards.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
automaticCards.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time

automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5186. This is the one School Mastery progression grant, not a second school choice or duplicate feat. source.originalText: | 5 | Bonus Feat: School Mastery |

automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5187. After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. automaticCards.name: Dual Cast
automaticCards.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

automaticCards.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
automaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5190. Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

source.originalText: | 13 | Overchannel (cast a spell 1 tier higher once/day) |

completeCard.name: Serum Injection
completeCard.frequency: At will while legal doses remain
completeCard.effect: Serum Injection. Choose one equipped mutation and one prepared serum dose. Consume the dose, activate that mutation for 3 rounds and apply the serum profile for 3 rounds. Observe active-mutation limits, Strain legality and nonstacking same-profile bonuses.

source.originalText: Serum Injection: Activate a prepared mutation serum as a bonus action, triggering its effects for 3 rounds.

completeCard.name: Brutal Strike
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One creature within your weapon reach
completeCard.duration: Instantaneous; Stagger until end of target's next turn
completeCard.effect: Brutal Strike. Make one melee weapon attack using its normal ability. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon's type. The target makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Staggered, taking -1 on attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. This is not a full-turn denial.

source.originalText: Brutal Strike: A powerful attack that deals additional damage based on your Strength and has a chance to stagger the target.

completeCard.name: Combat Instinct
completeCard.effect: Combat Instinct. Gain +1 on initiative rolls. You cannot be Surprised while conscious unless the opposing creature's Stealth check exceeds your passive Perception by 5 or more. This does not grant extra Actions or movement before combat.

source.originalText: Combat Instinct: +5% initiative and +10% resistance to being surprised.

completeCard.name: Physical Conditioning
completeCard.effect: Physical Conditioning. Increase carrying, pushing, dragging and lifting capacity by 25%. You have advantage on Constitution checks and saving throws made specifically against forced marching, sustained physical exertion, suffocation from exertion or environmental fatigue.

source.originalText: Physical Conditioning: +10% carrying capacity and advantage on physical endurance checks.

completeCard.name: Serum Tolerance
completeCard.effect: Serum Tolerance. Negative side effects printed on serum profiles do not affect you. Strain generation and Strain penalties still apply normally. This does not suppress drawbacks printed on mutation cards, Hero transformations or Mutation Overload.

source.originalText: Serum Tolerance: You can consume serums without the normal toxicity effects that would affect others.

completeCard.name: Survival Instinct
completeCard.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeCard.effect: Survival Instinct. Gain +2 on Perception checks, +2 on Dexterity saving throws and one additional Reaction usable only for Dodge-like defensive reactions, opportunity-free movement granted by a feature, or Deflect-style mitigation. It cannot make an attack or trigger another additional Reaction.

source.originalText: Survival Instinct: Enter a heightened state of awareness, gaining bonuses to perception and reaction time for a short duration.

completeCard.name: Mutation Efficiency
completeCard.effect: Mutation Efficiency. You may maintain up to two equipped mutations active simultaneously instead of one. Activating a third mutation while two are already active requires choosing one active mutation to become dormant unless another explicit feature temporarily raises this limit. Mutation slots, serum costs, Strain and mutation durations remain unchanged.

source.originalText: Mutation Efficiency: May have 2 active mutations at once (Lv 3)

completeCard.name: Mutation Overload
completeCard.duration: 2 rounds; backlash until end of following turn
completeCard.effect: Mutation Overload. For 2 rounds, enhance each currently active mutation once: an AC, DR, attack, save or flat-damage bonus increases by 1; a movement or reach bonus increases by 5 feet; or one mutation damage/healing roll gains +1d4. Immunities, target counts, resource generation and action grants cannot be increased. When Overload ends, you suffer -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and -5 feet Speed until the end of your next regular turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the Strain cap.

source.originalText: Mutation Overload: Push your mutations beyond safe limits, gaining significantly enhanced effects for 2 rounds followed by exhaustion.

completeCard.name: Mutation Adaptation
completeCard.effect: Mutation Adaptation. Ignore the Strain-2 Speed penalty. The first time in each encounter that activating a mutation or serum would add Strain, reduce that Strain gain by 1, minimum 0. This reduction cannot reduce Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload below 1 Strain and cannot reduce existing Strain.

source.originalText: Mutation Adaptation: Your body has been conditioned to accept mutations with reduced side effects.

completeCard.name: Brutal Fortitude
completeCard.effect: Brutal Fortitude. Reduce damage you take by 1 for each current BT, to a maximum DR 3 from this feature. Stack Overflow can raise your BT cap to 4 but does not raise Brutal Fortitude above DR 3. Losing or spending BT immediately lowers this DR.

source.originalText: Brutal Fortitude: Gain +1 DR for each BT stack (max +3)

completeCard.name: Crushing Advance
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Self; 20-foot straight movement path and creatures crossed or approached within 5 feet
completeCard.effect: Crushing Advance. Move up to 20 feet in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enemy no more than one size larger whose space or reach-line you pass through or adjacent to makes a Strength save. On failure it takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage, is pushed to the nearest legal space outside your path and falls Prone. On success it takes half damage and is neither pushed nor Prone. A creature is affected once per use.

source.originalText: Crushing Advance: Once per long rest, move in a straight line up to 20 ft, knocking aside all enemies (STR save or fall prone, take 2d6)

completeCard.name: Pain Conversion
completeCard.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
completeCard.effect: Pain Conversion. After one damage event deals actual damage to you, gain a temporary Power bonus equal to floor(actual damage/10), minimum 1 and maximum 3. Until the end of your next regular turn, add that bonus to one Strength-based weapon damage roll or Strength check. A later trigger refreshes the duration and replaces the previous bonus rather than stacking.

source.originalText: Pain Conversion: Convert 10% of damage taken into temporary Strength bonus.

completeCard.name: Adaptive Tissue
completeCard.duration: Until completion of a short or long rest
completeCard.frequency: One remembered damage type at a time
completeCard.effect: Adaptive Tissue. When a critical hit deals acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder damage to you, gain resistance to one such damage type dealt by that hit until you complete a short or long rest. Gaining a new Adaptive Tissue resistance replaces the previous one. Immunity and duplicate resistance do not stack.

source.originalText: Adaptive Tissue: Gain resistance to the last damage type that critically hit you until your next rest.

completeCard.name: Brutality Momentum
completeCard.effect: Brutality Momentum. When you personally reduce a creature marked Vulnerable by Brutality Sense to 0 HP with a melee attack, set Brutal Strike's positive round-recharge counter to 0 if it has not already been reset or shortened this round. This restores no Action and cannot refresh a per-rest use. Trivial, summoned or friendly creatures cannot trigger it.

source.originalText: Brutality Momentum: Killing a marked vulnerable target instantly readies your next Brutal Strike.

completeCard.name: Protective Mutations
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 5 feet while you have at least one active mutation
completeCard.effect: Protective Mutations. While at least one mutation is active, each ally other than you within 5 feet reduces the first damage it takes each round by S, minimum 0. Multiple Protective Mutations do not stack. The protection ends immediately when the ally leaves the aura or you have no active mutation.

source.originalText: Protective Mutations: Your mutations generate a 5-foot aura that grants allies +10% damage resistance.

completeCard.name: Bulwark Mutation Tree
completeCard.effect: Bulwark Mutation Tree. Unlock the Wardborn-specific mutations Spinal Plating, Adrenal Overwatch and Living Cover as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots, require serum activation unless their card says otherwise, and obey all active-mutation, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not automatically equip or activate any of them.

source.originalText: Bulwark Mutation Tree: Unlocks mutations like:

completeCard.name: Brutality Sense
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Hostile creatures you can perceive within 60 feet
completeCard.effect: Brutality Sense. You know when a visible hostile creature is at or below one-quarter of its maximum HP; it is Vulnerable for your Warrior features that specifically reference a marked vulnerable target. This does not reveal its exact HP or hidden resistances.

source.originalText: Brutality Sense: You can sense when an opponent is below 25% health, marking them as vulnerable.

automaticCards.name: Brutality Threshold Tracker
automaticCards.effect: Track Brutality Progress and BT using the common Warrior engine. Default BT cap is 3. Encounter end resets both to 0.

automaticCards.name: Mutagen Injection
automaticCards.cost: +1 Strain
automaticCards.effect: Choose Power or Guard. Power grants +2 Strength, maximum 22 from this feature. Guard grants +2 AC. This emergency mutagen does not consume a prepared serum dose and does not activate a mutation.

source.originalText: | 2 | Mutagen Injection (1/rest: +2 STR or +2 AC for 3 rounds) |

automaticCards.name: Mutation Slot II
automaticCards.effect: Gain a second mutation slot. This does not by itself raise the active-mutation concurrency limit.

source.originalText: | 5 | Mutation Slot II unlocked |

automaticCards.name: Bone Hardened
automaticCards.effect: While you are not Staggered, reduce physical weapon damage you take by 1 after resistance and before temporary HP.

source.originalText: | 6 | Bone Hardened: DR +1 while not staggered |

automaticCards.cost: Consume 2 prepared serum doses; +2 Strain
automaticCards.effect: Inject two different prepared serum profiles simultaneously and activate up to two eligible equipped mutations, respecting your active-mutation limit. Resolve both profile effects; same-stat bonuses use the stronger. Overclock is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.

source.originalText: | 9 | Serum Overclock: Inject 2 serums at once |

completeCard.name: Divine Smite
completeCard.effect: Divine Smite. Tags: smite, divine. Make a Cleric technique attack against one enemy. On a hit, deal S d8 + M radiant damage. This is one damage event. Invocation Path bonuses and features explicitly referring to Smite may modify it.

source.originalText: Divine Smite: Channel divine energy into a powerful strike against a single enemy, dealing damage based on your Wisdom and consuming 1 Conviction.

completeCard.name: Healing Rite
completeCard.effect: Healing Rite. Tags: rite, healing. One living ally regains S d8 + M HP. It cannot restore a dead creature or remove Wounds. Consecrated Ground and appropriate Invocation Path bonuses may modify this healing.

source.originalText: Healing Rite: A channeled ability that restores health to an ally, with increased effectiveness on consecrated ground.

completeCard.name: Conviction Pool
completeCard.effect: Conviction Pool. Tags: conviction, passive. Increase your Conviction maximum by 2. This changes only the maximum; it does not immediately restore spent Conviction when acquired during play. A long rest restores Conviction to the new maximum.

source.originalText: Conviction Pool: +2 max Conviction cap.

completeCard.name: Consecrated Ground
completeCard.effect: Consecrated Ground. Tags: rite, healing, passive. Whenever one of your healing Rites restores HP to a living creature standing in terrain created by your Consecrate feature, that creature regains S additional HP. Apply this once per creature per Rite pulse; it is flat healing and is not itself another healing trigger.

source.originalText: Consecrated Ground: Healing allies on terrain you sanctify (via Rite) heals for +10%.

completeCard.name: Judging Light
completeCard.effect: Judging Light. Tags: smite, passive. When your Divine Smite damages a creature currently affected by a Cursed or Weakened condition, add S d4 radiant damage to that Smite. Roll these dice once as part of the Smite; they do not create a second hit or trigger.

source.originalText: Judging Light: Smite deals +20% bonus damage to enemies afflicted by Cursed or Weakened effects.

completeCard.name: Fervent Ritualist
completeCard.effect: Fervent Ritualist. Tags: rite, ritual, passive. When a Rite with a Ritual activation normally requires at least 10 minutes, reduce its required time by 1 minute for each full 10 minutes of its printed casting time. This never reduces a Ritual below 1 minute and does not alter Action, Bonus Action or Reaction Rites.

source.originalText: Fervent Ritualist: +10% faster channel speed on all Rites.

completeCard.name: Divine Invocation
completeCard.effect: Divine Invocation. Tags: invocation, bishop. Use only your selected Invocation Path. Radiance: up to 3 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP; one may end Frightened or Poisoned. Judgment: one enemy within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save, taking (S+1)d8 radiant on failure or half on success; failure also applies Judged for 2 rounds. Renewal: up to 2 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP and 5 Stamina. Flame: creatures in a 15-foot cone make Dexterity saves, taking (S+1)d8 fire on failure or half on success; failed targets also take 1d6 fire at the start of their next turn. Veil: up to 3 allies within 30 feet can see invisible/ethereal creatures within 30 feet and gain advantage on saves against illusions for 3 rounds. Echoes: choose one eligible Smite or Rite you resolved this turn or previous regular turn and one original target within 30 feet; repeat 50% of its immediate unmodified rolled damage or healing dice, rounded down once, minimum 1 for a positive source, with no copied conditions, resources or triggers.

source.originalText: Divine Invocation: Channel a powerful prayer based on your chosen Invocation Path, with effects ranging from mass healing to divine fire or protective barriers.

completeCard.name: Aura of Faith
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 15 feet who can perceive you
completeCard.effect: Aura of Faith. Tags: aura, bishop. Allies in the aura gain +1 on saving throws. Whenever your Rite restores HP to an ally in the aura, that ally also regains 1 additional HP. Multiple Aura of Faith bonuses do not stack.

source.originalText: Aura of Faith: Allies in range gain +5% healing received and +1 to saves.

completeCard.name: Sacred Chant
completeCard.effect: Sacred Chant. Tags: chant, sustained, conviction. Pulse on start and once when maintained on each later regular turn with a Bonus Action. Under the base feature, the third pulse generates 1 Conviction. Only a real encounter can generate Conviction this way. Maintenance itself does not otherwise heal, damage or grant Conviction.

source.originalText: Sacred Chant: A sustained prayer that generates 1 Conviction every 3 turns while maintained.

completeCard.name: Consecrate
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius fixed zone centered at a point within 30 feet
completeCard.effect: Consecrate. Tags: rite, zone. Create sanctified terrain. Your Consecrated Ground feature recognizes this zone. Undead creatures in the zone have -1 on attack rolls. A creature leaving the zone loses that penalty immediately. Only one Consecrate zone created by you may exist at a time; creating another ends the first.

source.originalText: Consecrate: Sanctify the ground in a 15-foot radius, creating consecrated terrain that enhances your healing abilities and weakens undead enemies.

completeCard.name: Divine Insight
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Self; subject matter concerning a religious matter, sacred location or divine presence
completeCard.effect: Divine Insight. Tags: ritual, information. Ask the Director one specific factual question about a religious practice, sacred location, divine presence or recognized supernatural sign available to your tradition. Receive one truthful fact, symbolic clue or 'unknown' if the information is genuinely unavailable. This never forces certainty about future events or another character's private beliefs.

source.originalText: Divine Insight: Commune briefly with your deity to gain insight about a religious matter, sacred location, or divine presence.

completeCard.name: Sermon of Purpose
completeCard.effect: Sermon of Purpose. Tags: chant, conviction, bishop. Sacred Chant generates its 1 Conviction on its second pulse instead of its third. A normal three-pulse Sacred Chant still generates only 1 Conviction total unless another feature explicitly extends it or grants an additional generation event.

source.originalText: Sermon of Purpose: Chants now generate 1 Conviction every 2 turns.

completeCard.name: Liturgical Flow
completeCard.effect: Liturgical Flow. Tags: rite, invocation, recharge. If you start Rites on two consecutive regular turns, your next Divine Invocation started before the end of your following regular turn sets its printed round-recharge counter 1 lower, minimum 0. This counts as Divine Invocation's one allowed reset or shortening for that round.

source.originalText: Liturgical Flow: Chaining 2 Rites reduces cooldown of your next Invocation by 1 turn.

completeCard.name: Anointed Guardian
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: First ally within 30 feet to fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less
completeCard.effect: Anointed Guardian. Tags: protection, bishop. The first qualifying ally in an encounter gains a ward for 2 rounds. The first time during each round that ally takes damage, reduce that damage by PB + M, minimum 0. The ward does not prevent conditions attached to an attack unless the damage reduction itself invalidates them under another rule.

source.originalText: Anointed Guardian: First time an ally drops below 20% HP per combat, grant them a 30% damage reduction shield for 2 rounds.

completeCard.name: Blood Sacrifice
completeCard.cost: Lose S+M actual HP from yourself or one willing ally within 5 ft
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Self or one willing ally within 5 feet
completeCard.duration: Empowerment lasts until end of your next regular turn
completeCard.effect: Blood Sacrifice. Tags: cultist, sacrifice, conviction. The chosen creature loses S+M actual HP; this loss cannot be reduced, redirected or transferred and cannot reduce it below 1 HP. The donor must have strictly more current HP than this cost before activation; otherwise it is illegal. You gain 1 Conviction. Your next damaging or healing Rite or Invocation before the end of your next regular turn adds 1d8 to one rolled damage or healing component. A creature must be willing unless the target is you.

source.originalText: Blood Sacrifice: Sacrifice a portion of your health or an ally's to generate Conviction and empower your next divine ability.

completeCard.name: Sanguine Rite
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Self and one ally within 30 feet
completeCard.frequency: At most once on each of your turns
completeCard.effect: Sanguine Rite. Tags: cultist, rite, healing. When one of your Rites deals damage to at least one enemy, choose one living ally within 30 feet. That ally regains HP equal to half the actual damage dealt to one chosen damaged enemy, rounded down, maximum S+M HP. This healing cannot trigger Sanguine Rite again.

source.originalText: Sanguine Rite:  Rites damage enemies and heal allies for a portion of the same amount.

completeCard.name: Sanctified Reprisal
completeCard.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
completeCard.effect: Sanctified Reprisal. Tags: healing, smite, bishop. After one of your Cleric features restores HP to a living creature, empower your next Divine Smite before the end of your next regular turn. On a hit it deals S d4 additional radiant damage. If the target is Undead, it must also make a Constitution save; failure Stuns it until the end of its next turn.

source.originalText: Sanctified Reprisal: Whenever you heal, next Smite deals 20% more damage and stuns Undead.

completeCard.name: Blasphemous Tongue
completeCard.duration: Until the next Sacrament pulse or effect end
completeCard.effect: Blasphemous Tongue. Tags: cultist, sacrament, doomed. At each pulse of your Sacrament, each enemy affected by that pulse makes a Wisdom save. On failure it becomes Doomed until the next pulse. While Doomed, HP healing it receives is reduced by S+M, minimum 0, and each positive timed buff on it counts down one additional round at the end of its turn. Repeated failures refresh rather than stack.

source.originalText: Blasphemous Tongue: Sacraments inflict Doomed, reducing healing received and buff duration.

completeCard.name: Miraculous Channel
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Your next ally-targeting Rite this turn
completeCard.effect: Miraculous Channel. Tags: rite, channel, bishop. Your next Rite this turn that normally affects one or more willing allies may affect up to six legal willing allies within the Rite's normal range instead. Roll shared healing or numeric effects once and apply normally. It does not multiply hostile targets, corpse targets or resource generation.

source.originalText: Miraculous Channel: Sacrificing 3 Conviction causes your next Rite to affect the full party.

completeCard.name: Dark Conviction
completeCard.frequency: At most once on each of your turns
completeCard.effect: Dark Conviction. Tags: cultist, conviction. During a real encounter, when a hostile non-summoned creature that meaningfully threatened the party dies after taking damage from one of your Cleric features since the start of your current turn, gain 1 Conviction. Friendly creatures, summoned creatures, trivial staged creatures and repeated corpse destruction never qualify.

source.originalText: Dark Conviction: Killing an enemy grants 1 Conviction instantly.

completeCard.name: Sacrament
completeCard.cost: 3 Conviction + 4 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance
completeCard.effect: Sacrament. Tags: sacrament, rite, sustained, zone. Pulse on start and on each paid Bonus Action maintenance. At each pulse, up to three allies in the zone gain +1 on saving throws until the start of your next regular turn or effect end, whichever is first. Up to three Undead or Fiends in the zone make Wisdom saves, taking S d6 radiant damage on failure or half on success. Maximum 3 pulses.

source.originalText: Sacrament: Perform a sacred ceremony that consumes Conviction to create a powerful, sustained effect in an area.

completeCard.name: Ritual of Undeath
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One eligible corpse within 30 feet or one living ally within 30 feet
completeCard.effect: Ritual of Undeath. Tags: cultist, undead, rite. Choose one mode. Corpse Servant: one humanoid corpse dead no more than 1 minute rises for 3 rounds as a temporary thrall with AC 13, 10 HP, Speed 30 feet and one attack only when you spend your shared companion Bonus Action command using your Cleric technique attack bonus; on hit it deals S d6 necrotic. The thrall disappears at 0 HP or when duration ends and grants no XP, loot, new corpse, Conviction or resurrection target. Death Ward: one living ally is marked for 1 minute; the first time it would die during that duration, it instead remains at 1 HP and counts as both humanoid and undead until the end of its next turn. Neither mode removes Wounds. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Ritual of Undeath: Perform a forbidden ritual that can temporarily raise fallen enemies as servants or prevent allies from dying by transforming them into undead-like entities.

automaticCards.name: Invocation Attunement
automaticCards.effect: Invocation Attunement. Tags: invocation, core. At Cleric level 2 choose exactly one Invocation Path: Radiance, Judgment, Renewal, Flame, Veil or Echoes. You automatically gain that path's listed bonus. Divine Invocation thereafter uses that path's mode unless another feature explicitly overrides it.

source.originalText: Invocation Attunement: Choose one Invocation Path (see below); gain a permanent passive tied to it.

automaticCards.name: Bishop's Mandate
automaticCards.rangeAndTarget: Your Sacrament and one legal Divine Invocation target set
automaticCards.frequency: Automatic at Cleric 9; once per Sacrament start
automaticCards.effect: Bishop's Mandate. Tags: sacrament, invocation, capstone. When you legally start Sacrament, immediately resolve one free Divine Invocation using your selected Invocation Path. This free Invocation requires no Action, RP or Conviction, sets no Divine Invocation recharge and cannot itself trigger Bishop's Mandate. The Sacrament's own Conviction expenditure may still vent Dissonance normally.

source.originalText: Capstone: Bishop's Mandate: Activating a Sacrament automatically casts a free Invocation without cost or cooldown.

completeCard.name: Quick Shot
completeCard.effect: Make one ranged weapon attack, dealing weapon die only without ability damage modifier. Does not trigger Extra Attack or another Quick Shot; may gain one Hit Chain point at 11 within the turn cap.

source.originalText: Quick Shot: Fire a rapid arrow that deals less damage but can be used as part of another action.

completeCard.name: Twin Strike
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One or 2 enemies in melee reach; two light weapons wielded
completeCard.effect: Make one attack with each weapon. Add ability modifier to first hit only. These are the full attacks for this Action; do not add ordinary Extra Attack. Hit Chain gains at 11 cap 2 per turn.

source.originalText: Twin Strike: Make a swift attack with both melee weapons when dual wielding.

completeCard.name: Weapon Bond
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One bow or pair of blades touched
completeCard.effect: Bond weapons. Bonus Action summons one bonded weapon to your hand from within 30 ft if not held by another creature and no total cover. Cannot disarm someone or cross planar boundaries; bond no additional items.

source.originalText: Weapon Bond: Form a special connection with either a bow or a pair of blades, allowing you to summon them to your hand.

completeCard.name: Track Target
completeCard.effect: You have advantage on Survival checks to follow its physical tracks for 1 hour after the mark ends. While it is marked, once/turn your first hit also ignores 2 points of nonmagical flat damage reduction. Does not pierce immunity or reveal through cover.

source.originalText: Track Target: Mark an enemy to deal +10% damage and enable special abilities against them.

completeCard.name: Natural Explorer
completeCard.effect: Advantage on Survival checks in natural terrain; ignore nonmagical difficult terrain caused by vegetation, loose earth, mud or snow. Magical terrain, climbing and hazards still require their own rules.

source.originalText: Natural Explorer: Gain advantage on Survival checks and move normally through difficult natural terrain.

completeCard.name: Keen Senses
completeCard.effect: Gain+2 Perception and passive Perception. You still need a sense that can detect the target; this does not reveal invisible creatures automatically or read tracks through solid stone.

source.originalText: Keen Senses: Gain enhanced perception in natural environments, making it harder for creatures to hide from you.

completeCard.name: Pathfinder's Mark
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One fixed visible point within 30 ft
completeCard.effect: Know direction and rough distance to the point within 10 miles on same plane. A new mark replaces old. It does not create teleportation, observe occupants or reveal a path through barriers.

source.originalText: Pathfinder's Mark: Place a magical mark on a location that you can sense the direction and distance to for 24 hours.

completeCard.name: Ignore Difficult Terrain
completeCard.effect: Ignore movement cost increases from difficult terrain, including magical terrain. You still suffer its separate damage, restraints and hazards, and cannot cross impassable walls or surfaces without movement capability.

source.originalText: Ignore Difficult Terrain: Move normally through any type of difficult terrain.

completeCard.name: Combat Focus
completeCard.effect: Choose one: Precision adds 1 to first ranged attack each turn against quarry; Momentum gives+5 ft Speed after switching weapon mode; Wild Hunt gives advantage on Survival to follow injured creatures and+1 initiative. Choices do not stack; no general retraining.

source.originalText: Combat Focus: Choose one combat style (Precision, Momentum, or Wild Hunt) that enhances your fighting abilities.

completeCard.name: Enhanced Stealth and Perception
completeCard.effect: Gain+2 Stealth and Perception. It does not stack with Keen Senses on Perception; use+2 total from these class features. Advantage from another feature is separate.

source.originalText: Enhanced Stealth and Perception: Gain +2 to Stealth and Perception checks.

completeCard.name: Nature's Whisper
completeCard.effect:
Gain advantage on one Perception/Survival check to find tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage. It reveals evidence on success, not automatically creatures through total cover, incorporeal beings or thoughts.

NEW NWQ-01 classification: this exact card is a magical nonspell class technique, not an ordinary spell, class spell, cantrip, Echo release or Matrix cast. Preserve spellRank:null and the historical originalText; no rank, school, spell component block, repertoire, spellcasting credential or class engine is inferred from its name, its historical minor-spell wording or its 1 RP cost.

NEW NWQ-02 activation: no verbal, somatic, focus, material, command-word or audible channel is required by the technique itself. You must be conscious, capable of the required Action, legitimately entitled to this exact activation, ready on its own recharge ledger, and able to perceive and have line of effect to the selected actual natural terrain within 15 feet. Silence, occupied hands or lack of a casting focus alone do not prohibit it. Actual suppression or a prohibition whose operative scope covers this magical technique still applies. The later investigation keeps its own senses, hands, tools, access and task requirements. A permitted borrowed activation separately requires Versatile Mastery's actual donor preparation, consent and perceived/understood signal; the technique supplies no communication channel.

KEEP shared technique strain: pay 1 actual RP from your own existing lawful personal pool, not a donor pool or newly granted pool. No ordinary spell-rank price, spell strain surcharge, automatic spell Dissonance, Refrain update, remembered-spell-name change, Fracture ranked-cast prohibition or rank-based trauma is applied by this activation. It does not clear, advance, consume or vent an ordinary spell-cadence record. Do not invent a casting ability or recompute a strain Limit for it. A later Perception or Survival check uses your own current applicable task ability and actual proficiency or replacing Expertise, ordinarily Wisdom, not a donor modifier or automatic borrowed skill proficiency. There is no activation attack or saving-throw DC. Its legal commitment is a magical-ability-use event: it prevents idle-turn Dissonance recovery on the actor's regular turn containing that commitment, including when the paid activation is interrupted. An illegal uncommitted declaration is not such an event. Merely retaining the rider or applying it to a later ordinary task is not another activation. Extra turns and off-turn releases create no additional recovery tick and cannot rewrite a completed tick. Actual separately acquired hooks operate only on their exact triggers; this is not a Bard Performance or an ordinary Ranger spell cast, and it grants no donor Track Target, Hit Chain, stabilization, Crescendo or Echo engine.

NEW NWQ-04 commitment and area: before payment, declare this source, actor and one fixed investigation area consisting only of the actual natural terrain within 15 feet of the actor's commitment position that is then perceivable and has line of effect. Record that area and position; the area does not follow the actor and no moving aura or remote sensor is created. Actual hidden clues need not already be known or present to make an otherwise lawful investigation site eligible. Commit the legal Action and 1 RP together, set the actor's same-card Recharge counter to 3, and, for borrowing, spend the single Versatile Mastery use at that same commitment. Record donor provenance without spending any donor resource. A rejected precommit declaration spends none of these costs. Resolve the activation within that same action after only genuinely applicable source-defined interruptions; there is no automatic Counterspell window, opposed cast roll or concentration test. Ordinary Counterspell and rank-limited spell dispels do not acquire this nonspell target. A separately sourced interrupt or suppression must actually cover it; ordinary damage alone does not add a concentration requirement. If the actor cannot finish the activation or its fixed terrain is no longer legally in range, perceivable and reachable by line of effect at resolution, the paid activation fails without a new area or refund. Borrowing's donor condition is tested at actual activation commitment, not imposed as a new continuing tether after receipt of the signal.

NEW NWQ-04 rider and check: a surviving activation gives this actor one unused rider from actual resolution until resolution time plus 60 elapsed seconds; the exact deadline is not renewed by travel, turns, initiative changes, donor departure or the borrowed permission ending. No concentration is required. At most one unused Nature's Whisper rider belongs to that actor across native and borrowed uses; a new successful resolution replaces an older unused rider, not stacks or banks checks. A failed or interrupted new activation does not itself replace an older otherwise valid rider. Before any dice or outcome are supplied, voluntarily bind the rider to one separately lawful and paid Perception or Survival check about tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage in the original fixed area. The relevant terrain/evidence must still be natural, within 15 feet of the actor and accessible to the task's actual senses and line of effect; no total-cover, thoughts, incorporeal-detection or automatic-revelation exception is supplied. Consume the rider at that check's outcome commitment before rolling or determining its result, even if other advantage already exists, disadvantage cancels it, the legal check fails, or a genuine interruption then prevents its result. An invalid check declaration does not consume the rider or grant a free roll. A paid longer task whose check reaches adjudication at or after the deadline receives no rider. Use ordinary task resolution and advantage cancellation; no passive-score adjustment, extra degree effect, free check, new retry or second bonus is granted. Reveal only real evidence supported by the actual successful task and observer rules; unknown data is not proof of absence. Failure does not reveal otherwise hidden facts. Expired, consumed or ended riders cannot be reclaimed by repeating a request.

KEEP generic nonspell Ready: this Action-time technique may be readied through the current Ready procedure. Ready setup spends its Action and records one perceivable trigger; it does not activate Nature's Whisper, pay its RP/feat use, start its Recharge, start its minute, update spell history or create held-spell concentration. On a legal release before Ready expires, spend the required permitted Reaction and perform the actual activation commitment instead of another Action; recheck its own entitlement, recharge, personal RP, terrain and, for borrowing, the prepared donor/signal conditions at that release. An invalid or declined trigger spends no release resource and may await another valid trigger within the same Ready window. Unreleased, replaced or expired Ready loses its setup Action but not an unspent Nature/feat cost. A legally released then interrupted activation retains all committed costs and Recharge. Native and borrowed copies use the actor's same source-ID recharge history; borrowing does not refresh it or the donor's history. Recharge 3 ticks once at each subsequent owner regular-turn start, or once per six elapsed seconds outside initiative without double counting; extra Actions and extra turns do not tick it. A recharge becoming ready grants no new borrowed feat use.

source.originalText: Nature's Whisper: Cast a minor nature spell that reveals hidden creatures or tracks within a small area.

completeCard.name: Tactical Draw
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Self after switching melee/ranged weapon mode
completeCard.effect: Gain+1 AC after making an attack with the new mode. Drawing/stowing alone is insufficient. Further switches refresh neither extra AC nor actions.

source.originalText: Tactical Draw: Gain +1 AC after switching from bow to blade or vice versa.

completeCard.name: Skirmisher's Step
completeCard.effect: Move up to half Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Supplied movement does not increase remaining normal movement. Requires an unblocked route; no teleport or escape from restraints.

source.originalText: Skirmisher's Step: Move half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

completeCard.name: Vigilant Heart
completeCard.effect: You cannot be surprised by a creature you can perceive. Gain advantage on saves against scrying; on success learn someone attempted it but not identity/location. No blanket immunity to divination.

source.originalText: Vigilant Heart: Become immune to surprise and scrying attempts.

completeCard.name: Rootcall Quake
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in 10 ft-radius ground area within 60 ft
completeCard.effect: STR save or Speed 0. Each affected target repeats save at end of each turn and may use Action to attempt escape using STR(Athletics) against class DC. Flying creatures not touching ground are unaffected.

source.originalText: Rootcall Quake: Create an area effect that roots enemies in place.

completeCard.name: Living Pulse
completeCard.effect: You may pay 1 RP to regain 2 HP. Does not trigger when Downed or incapacitated, cannot exceed maximum and never counts as another healing spell. Replaces unlimited passive regeneration with a finite cost.

source.originalText: Living Pulse: Regenerate 2 HP per round while in natural terrain.

completeCard.name: Elemental Attunement
completeCard.effect: Choose fire/cold/poison. Gain resistance to that damage and sense an exposed source of it within 15 ft. Does not infuse weapons, detect through total cover or identify exact poison recipes.

source.originalText: Elemental Attunement: Temporarily attune yourself to an element (fire, cold, or poison), gaining minor resistance and the ability to detect that element.

completeCard.name: Beast Empathy
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Natural beasts within 30 ft that hear you
completeCard.effect: Communicate simple emotions/directions. They are not automatically friendly or controlled, cannot answer beyond their experience, and may need normal Animal Handling. No language-based compulsion or extra companion slot.

source.originalText: Beast Empathy: Communicate basic concepts with natural beasts.

completeCard.name: Dual Style
completeCard.effect: Draw/stow a bow and up to 2 light melee weapons as one free exchange on your turn. This replaces normal object interaction for those weapons and cannot manipulate unrelated items or grant attacks.

source.originalText: Dual Style: Gain the ability to swap weapons as a free action (level 5).

completeCard.name: Warden's Vigilance
completeCard.effect: Learn direction of one substantial recent fire, poisoning or unnatural blight in the area. Does not locate arbitrary enemies or identify culprits. A protected or planar-hidden effect may remain undetected.

source.originalText: Warden's Vigilance: Detect threats to natural areas within a large radius.

completeCard.name: Elemental Imbue
completeCard.effect: Use the engine's fire/cold/poison Imbue: once/turn add 1d4 and its bounded elemental rider to a weapon hit. Switching element pays again. It does not stack multiple imbues or multiply Do Ts.

source.originalText: Elemental Imbue: Infuse your weapons with fire, cold, or poison to deal additional effects (level 6).

completeCard.name: Beast Companion
completeCard.cost: 4 RP; 1 hour with a willing/tamed eligible beast
completeCard.effect: Bond eligible beast using standard companion stats plus Wisdom modifier HP; preserve one movement mode up to 40 ft and keen-sense advantage. Bonus Action command gives one attack, no imported boss powers. Injury persists; heal normally. Death requires a new bond after long rest, not free resummoning.

source.originalText: Beast Companion: Tame one beast from the bestiary (CR ≤ your level, INT < 7, not corrupted) as a permanent companion that scales with your Wisdom and level.

operational.burdenedAtLoadOrPounds: positive supported load at least half the respective limit; one Burdened speed penalty, not two for the same state
operational.hardCarryAdmission: must meet both pounds/Load and physical fit; no routine movement above either full cap
operational.riderSizeRule: at least one size smaller; saddle and actual body compatible; both personal gear and rider equipment count
operational.drawLimitProvenance: NEW separate trained-harness capability on firm rolling surface or appropriate ice/snow runners; never a five-times Strength inference
operational.drawMovement: minimum actual puller speed and vehicle cap; a gross draw above half the combined draw rating also causes the one Burdened speed penalty. Loads on a puller and towing constraints are separately checked; the same named penalty is not doubled. No slopes, broken axles or impassable terrain waived.

attack.name: Kick
attack.activation: Action on its own independent regular turn only; one attack
attack.critical: Core natural20 doubles damage dice only; natural1 misses

operational.otherActions: independent actual creature may use physically compatible Core Actions; controlled ridden Action list is Dash, Disengage, Dodge only; no Multiattack or automatic opportunity attack while controlled
operational.deathRule: NEW default registered Expedition mount is significant and uses ordinary Core Wounds/dying/death saves. Mark significance before an encounter; no retrospective designation to dodge death. A later actual Ranger Beast bond uses its expressly different HP-only/immediate-death lifecycle instead.
operational.training: Actual ride/cargo/harness/armor training recorded separately under TR-02/07. Purchase name/price is not proof of present training, willingness or health. War-named template may be sold with documented combat habituation but gains no new controlled attack.

dailyFeed.meaning: NEW one animal-day sold feed quantity for this template at the printed5cp daily reference. Actual species-compatible stock must be supplied; no fodder-to-meat conversion or infinite vendor stock.

operational.foodCare: Use these NEW animal quantities instead of the human Small/Medium/Large Supply basket, with actual safe water and continued rest. Do not add human lamp oil demand to an animal. Unmet daily food/water gives at most1 ordinary expedition Strain for that day; no additional duplicate failure per missing component. No automatic desert-fasting trait.
operational.threatReferenceProvenance: NEW encounter-budget comparison only, not a CR, character class level, Ranger acquisition authorization or XP award
operational.sourceCR: absent; retain absence, and any actual CR-gated ability needs its genuine source/profile predicate rather than treating referenceLevel as CR
operational.custody: actual individual creature ID and original body history; Donkey or mule is one selected individual, not two. Purchase, hire, boarding, battle loss, rescue, bond and sale preserve that history.

Pony.typeQualification: NEW scene actual-Beast classification is an explicit required premise; the transport source itself labels living-mount and does not print a Beast tag or CR. Whole TR5-05-A positive remains qualified on that actual classification. No Ranger acquisition is proved.
Pony.sourceCR: absent; retain absence, and any actual CR-gated ability needs its genuine source/profile predicate rather than treating referenceLevel as CR
